name: Hotel Leitenhof
beschreibung: The Hotel Leitenhof is located in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser in the Austrian federal state of Tirol. The location is characterized by the mountain landscape of the Wilden Kaiser. In winter, the surroundings offer access to the Skiwelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental ski area, and in summer to a network of marked hiking trails and climbing routes. The hotel has a wellness area with sauna, steam bath, and an indoor pool. In the restaurant, regional dishes are served. The rooms are equipped with a balcony and offer views of the surrounding mountains. Guests can expect accommodation in a quiet location with opportunities for active recreation in nature.
